explanation: The two-job execution contains an upstream provenance fault. The evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values, so Job 2 cannot match provenance ranks to the needs record IDs and all observed upstream_rank values become 0. The supplied function source for assemble_provenance shows the cause: it writes record_id from record.get('source_id') instead of preserving record.get('record_id').
cited_evidence: assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, changing record identity from n06-rXX to sXX.
Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while needs and coverage use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Observed Job 2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record, demonstrating provenance rank was not joinable by record_id.
